In accordance with 7 CFR 205.404(c), this certificate continues in effect until surrendered by the certified operation, or suspended or revoked by the certifying agent, the State organic program's governing State official, or the Administrator. It therefore carries no expiration date. Continuation is contingent on the annual update of the organic system plan and the annual on-site inspection conducted on or about the anniversary date shown above.

Current status may be verified in the USDA Organic INTEGRITY Database or by contacting the certifying agent. This certificate must be reproduced in its entirety.
